name: Expert_CP_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a Stochastic oscillator combined with a moving average filter to generate trading signals within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It employs fixed-lot money management and no trailing stop, relying on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for trade exits. The signal threshold mechanism aggregates weighted filter signals before opening or closing positions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用随机振荡器结合移动平均线过滤器，在MQL5标准库专家顾问框架内生成交易信号。它采用固定手数的资金管理方式，不使用追踪止损，依靠固定的止损和止盈水平来平仓。信号阈值机制在开仓或平仓前聚合加权过滤器信号。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于随机振荡器(Stochastic)作为核心信号源，结合移动平均线(MA)作为辅助过滤条件。入场条件由随机振荡器的%K和%D线交叉以及超买超卖区域判断，同时需要移动平均线确认趋势方向，信号必须达到阈值(Signal_ThresholdOpen=10)才会开仓。出场条件包括反向信号达到平仓阈值(Signal_ThresholdClose=10)、止损(50点)或止盈(50点)触发。仓位管理采用固定手数方式(Money_FixLot_Lots=0.1)，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，固定百分比为10%，手数固定为0.1手，缺乏根据波动率或风险动态调整仓位的能力。整体策略属于均值回归类型，利用随机指标在超买超卖区间的回归特性进行交易，但止损止盈设置较小(50点)可能在波动较大的市场中频繁被止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy uses a Stochastic oscillator as the primary signal generator, combined with a moving average (MA) as an auxiliary filter. Entry conditions rely on Stochastic %K/%D line crossovers in overbought/oversold zones, confirmed by the MA for trend direction, and the aggregated signal must reach the opening threshold (Signal_ThresholdOpen=10) before a position is opened. Exit conditions include the reverse signal reaching the closing threshold (Signal_ThresholdClose=10), stop-loss (50 points) or take-profit (50 points) being hit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (Money_FixLot_Lots=0.1), which does not dynamically adjust based on account balance or volatility. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class with a fixed percentage of 10% and a fixed lot size of 0.1, lacking the ability to dynamically size positions based on volatility or risk. The overall strategy is mean-reversion in nature, exploiting the Stochastic indicator's tendency to revert from overbought/oversold levels, but the relatively tight stop-loss and take-profit (50 points each) may result in frequent stop-outs in volatile markets.

pros: 使用MQL5标准库框架，代码结构清晰规范，模块化程度高
随机振荡器结合移动平均线双重过滤，减少虚假信号
信号阈值机制提供灵活的开平仓控制，避免过度交易
固定手数降低了仓位管理复杂度，适合初学者使用
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library framework with clean, modular code structure
Stochastic oscillator combined with MA provides dual filtering to reduce false signals
Signal threshold mechanism offers flexible open/close control, preventing overtrading
Fixed lot sizing reduces position management complexity, suitable for beginners
cons: 止损止盈均为固定50点，未考虑市场波动率(ATR)动态调整，在不同市场条件下效果差异大
使用固定手数而非动态仓位管理，无法根据账户规模和风险自适应调整
未使用追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，可能无法充分捕捉趋势利润
缺少新K线检查机制(Expert_EveryTick=false但仍可能在同一K线重复操作)
未包含点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能导致不必要的损失
cons_en: Fixed 50-point stop-loss and take-profit without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, leading to inconsistent performance across varying market conditions
Fixed lot sizing instead of dynamic position management cannot adapt to account size and risk
No trailing stop used (CTrailingNone), potentially missing profits from extended trends
Lacks new bar check mechanism despite EveryTick=false, risking duplicate operations on the same bar
No spread filter included, which may cause unnecessary losses on high-spread instruments
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同市场波动率
添加追踪止损模块替代CTrailingNone，以保护已有利润并跟随趋势
增加点差过滤和新K线检查机制，提高交易执行的可靠性
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop-loss/take-profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to varying market volatility
Add a trailing stop module to replace CTrailingNone, protecting profits and following trends
Add spread filter and new bar check mechanism to improve trade execution reliability

risk_points: 固定止损50点在低波动市场可能过大，在高波动市场可能过小，风险不对称
缺乏新K线检查和点差过滤，存在重复入场和滑点风险
固定手数不考虑账户权益变化，在连续亏损时风险敞口不变
risk_points_en: Fixed 50-point stop-loss may be too wide in low-volatility markets and too tight in high-volatility markets, creating asymmetric risk
Lack of new bar check and spread filter creates risk of duplicate entries and slippage
Fixed lot sizing ignores account equity changes, maintaining constant risk exposure during losing streaks
